# WebKit

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 35.3% of Apple's iOS API (548 of 1551, exact) · **Rows:** 60% (10: 6 ✅ 4 ❌) · **iOS:** 16.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Web, network & communication](../COVERAGE.md#web) · **Apple:** [WebKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/webkit) · **Issues:** [`area:web`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aweb)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** WebKitGTK 6.0 in a helper process (`isim-webkit`). isim draws the pixels; the Objective-C names sit over the Swift overlay.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| WebKit `WKWebView` rendering and loading (`load`, `loadHTMLString`, `loadFileURL`, `load(_:mimeType:…)`, back/forward, reload, KVO `title`/`url`/`isLoading`/`estimatedProgress`/`canGoBack`) | ✅ | ≤17 | real WebKit: the host's WebKitGTK 6.0 in a helper process (`isim-webkit`, private invisible broadway display) renders frames at the screen scale; iOS-style user agent; history includes `loadHTMLString` pages. Adapted: no 980-px mobile viewport (pages lay out at the view width), `load` sends GET + headers only. Needs `webkitgtk-6.0` + `gtk4-broadwayd` on the host (else a placeholder and a failed navigation). Tested (HelloWeb) |
| WebKit delegates (`WKNavigationDelegate` action/response policy, start/commit/finish/fail; `WKUIDelegate` alert/confirm/prompt, `createWebViewWith`) | ✅ | ≤17 | completion and async forms; cancelled links; JavaScript panels through the app's UI delegate (none → dismissed like iOS). Tested; `createWebViewWith`, process termination unverified |
| WebKit JavaScript bridge (`evaluateJavaScript`, `callAsyncJavaScript`, content worlds, `WKUserScript`, `WKScriptMessageHandler`(`WithReply`), `WKURLSchemeHandler`) | ✅ | ≤17 | results converted like iOS (dictionaries, arrays, numbers, `WKError.javaScriptExceptionOccurred`, unsupported types); isolated worlds; replies to page promises. Tested |
| WebKit input, selection, scrolling, zoom, menus, find, PDF, web archives, website data (`WKWebsiteDataStore`, `WKHTTPCookieStore`), snapshots | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted input: taps, typing (system keyboard on focused fields) and scrolling become DOM events from an isolated world (`isTrusted` false); `scrollView` mirrors page scrolling. A long press selects a word (selection tint and handles, edit menu with Copy / Select All / Share…, `copy:` / `selectAll:`); a long press on a link or image opens a context menu with a live preview (`WKUIDelegate` `contextMenuConfigurationFor`, will-present, did-end, commit; else Open / Copy Link / Share…); `<select>` and `<select multiple>` become UIKit menus (option groups, disabled options, change events); pinch zoom within the viewport meta's scales (`user-scalable=no` honoured), `scrollView.zoomScale` follows; `isFindInteractionEnabled` / `findInteraction` (find navigator, highlights, n of m); `createPDF` (whole page or `WKPDFConfiguration.rect`, WebKit's print backend at CSS size, cropped with poppler) and `createWebArchiveData` (WebKit's MHTML as a webarchive plist: main resource and subresources). Cookies get/set/delete and data removal; `takeSnapshot`. Tested (test_web, test_web_interact) |
| SwiftUI `WebView` / `WebPage` (iOS 26) | ✅ | 26.0 | on WKWebView: `WebPage` is `@Observable` (`title`, `url`, `isLoading`, `estimatedProgress`, `currentNavigationEvent`), `load` (request, HTML, data) returning the navigation events as an `AsyncSequence`, `reload`, `callJavaScript` with arguments, `pdf`, `snapshot`, `webArchiveData`, `find`, `URLSchemeHandler`; `WebView(page)` / `WebView(url:)` with `webViewBackForwardNavigationGestures`, `webViewLinkPreviews`, `webViewMagnificationGestures`, `webViewContentBackground`. Tested (HelloWeb -webpage, test_web_webpage) |
| WebKit from Objective-C (`#import <WebKit/WebKit.h>`, `WKWebView` by its Objective-C name) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Objective-C headers over the Swift overlay's classes (Apple's class names and selectors, delegates, KVO, subclasses and categories from Objective-C, `evaluateJavaScript:`/`callAsyncJavaScript:` and the other completion-handler APIs). Tested: test_web_objc (HelloWebObjC); runs Google Mobile Ads ([#200](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues/200)) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `WKDownload`, `WKDownloadDelegate`, `WKWebView.FullscreenState` (3 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 18) | ❌ | 18.2 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `WKDownload.PlaceholderPolicy`, `WKWebExtension`, `WKWebExtension.Action`, `WKWebExtension.Command`, `WKWebExtension.DataRecord`, `WKWebExtension.DataRecord.Error`, `WKWebExtension.DataRecord.Error.Code`, `WKWebExtension.Error.Code`, `WKWebExtension.MatchPattern`, `WKWebExtension.MatchPattern.Error.Code`, `WKWebExtension.MessagePort`, `WKWebExtension.MessagePort.Error`, `WKWebExtension.MessagePort.Error.Code`, `WKWebExtension.TabConfiguration`, `WKWebExtension.WindowConfiguration`, `WKWebExtensionContext`, `WKWebExtensionContext.Error.Code`, `WKWebExtensionController`, `WKWebExtensionController.Configuration`, `WKWebExtensionControllerDelegate`, `WKWebExtensionTab`, `WKWebExtensionWindow` (22 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `URLScheme`, `WebPage.BackForwardList.Item`, `WebPage.BackForwardList.Item.ID`, `WebPage.Configuration.MediaPlaybackBehavior`, `WebPage.DeviceSensorAuthorization`, `WebPage.DeviceSensorAuthorization.Permission`, `WebPage.FrameInfo`, `WebPage.NavigationAction`, `WebPage.NavigationDeciding`, `WebPage.NavigationPreferences`, `WebPage.NavigationPreferences.ContentMode`, `WebPage.NavigationPreferences.SecurityRestrictionMode`, `WebPage.NavigationPreferences.UpgradeToHTTPSPolicy`, `WebPage.NavigationResponse`, `WKSecurityRestrictionMode` (15 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `WebPage.FormInfo`, `WKContentWorld.Configuration`, `WKDOMNodeSnapshot`, `WKFormInfo`, `WKJSHandle` (5 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
